notices.title: A new version of Lunchbox is available
notices.body: You're on 0.1.1, which can't update itself on a Mac. Paste one line in Terminal and Lunchbox updates and reopens with everything as it was. After that, updates take one click.

notices.title: Lunchbox 0.1.9 is ready
notices.body: Effort now sits in the model menu, you pick who builds in the Workshop, every theme keeps to its own colours, and the whole app moves without jumps. One click updates it, and your rooms and settings stay as they are.

notices.title: Lunchbox 0.1.9 is ready
notices.body: Google's agent through Antigravity, a Workshop that builds what you ask for into your own Lunchbox, slash commands from all your agents, effort in the model menu, and themes that reach the whole app. One click updates it, and your rooms and settings stay as they are.

notices.title: Lunchbox 0.1.9 is here
notices.body: Google's agent through Antigravity, a Workshop that builds what you ask for into your own Lunchbox, slash commands from all your agents, and themes that reach the whole app. It downloads by itself: click Restart now at the top of the window, or quit and reopen Lunchbox.
